translations.web: With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
translations.bsb: With many other words he testified, and he urged them, “Be saved from this corrupt generation.”
translations.kjv: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
